section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details a study conducted in Iran, focusing on the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 among a university population of men and women. The study found a one-factor structure for the Persian BAS-2, consistent with previous research. It also explored correlations between BAS-2 scores and other variables, noting a negative association with BMI in women and a positive association in men, which contradicts some prior findings. The study acknowledges limitations including the university-based sample, self-reported BMI, and lack of ethnicity data.
section_summary.evidence_source: The present study aimed to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran. Findings suggested that the Persian BAS-2 has a one-factor structure among men and women from a university population. Of note, the Persian BAS-2 was negatively associated with BMI in women. BMI and BMI2 were positively associated with body appreciation in men. The present study has several limitations. First, the present data were collected in university settings and may reflect attitudes of a subset of Iranian population. Second, self-reported BMI was used. Fourth, questions about participants' ethnicity and cultural background were not asked.
